New release of EEST tests for Devnet-3 is available here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/pectra-devnet-3%40v1.2.0

Please take into account that these tests need to be (ideally) all passed before an execution client can join Pectra Devnet-3, and if you find any issues with the fixtures please let me know 🙌
